## CBOE Indices

### CBOE Indices List
**Docs:** [CBOE Indices List](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/cboe-europe-indices-api-beta#CBOE_Indices_List_API)


```
GET /cboe/indices
```

**Cost:** 10 API calls. Plans: All-In-One, Fundamentals Data Feed.

**Response:** `{meta: {total}, data: [{id, type: "cboe-index", attributes: {region, index_code, feed_type, date, index_close, index_divisor}}], links: {next}}` — paginate by following `links.next` until it is null.

### CBOE Index Historical Data
**Docs:** [CBOE Index Data](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/cboe-europe-indices-api-beta#2_CBOE_Index_Feed_API)


```
GET /cboe/index
```

**Parameters (all three filters are required; HTTP 422 otherwise):**

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api_token` | Yes | string | API key |
| `filter[index_code]` | Yes | string | CBOE Europe index code from `/cboe/indices` (e.g., `BAT20N`, `BDE30P`, `BNL30N`) |
| `filter[feed_type]` | Yes | string | `snapshot_official_closing`, `snapshot_official_opening` or `snapshot_pro_forma_closing` |
| `filter[date]` | Yes | YYYY-MM-DD | Trading date (use a `date` present in the `/cboe/indices` attributes) |
| `filter[include_review]` | No | boolean | Include review data |
| `fmt` | No | string | `json` (default) or `xml` |

**Cost:** 10 API calls

```bash
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/cboe/index?filter[index_code]=BNL30N&filter[feed_type]=snapshot_official_opening&filter[date]=2025-09-22&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
```

**Component fields include:** symbol, isin, name, sedol, cusip, country, closing_price, currency, total_shares, market_cap, free_float_factor, index_weighting, sector

## WebSocket Real-Time
**Docs:** [WebSocket Real-Time](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/new-real-time-data-api-websockets)


Real-time streaming with <50ms latency for US and European equities, forex and crypto. Does NOT consume API calls. Plans: All-In-One, EOD+Intraday — All World Extended.

**Host:** `wss://ws.eodhistoricaldata.com` — append `?api_token=YOUR_KEY` to every endpoint.

| Market | Trades | Quotes (bid/ask) | 1-minute bars | Trading status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| US stocks | `/ws/us` | `/ws/us-quote` | `/ws/us-candles` | `/ws/us-status` |
| European stocks | `/ws/eu` | `/ws/eu-quote` | `/ws/eu-candles` | `/ws/eu-status` |
| Forex | `/ws/forex` | — | — | — |
| Crypto | `/ws/crypto` | — | — | — |

**Symbols:** US — plain ticker (`AAPL`); Europe — `TICKER.EXCHANGE` (`GSK.LSE`); forex — `EURUSD`; crypto — `BTC-USD`.

**Limits:** 50 symbols per API token by default (upgradeable in the dashboard), max 64 concurrent connections per token across all markets. Must re-subscribe after a reconnect.

**Subscribe / unsubscribe:**
```json
{"action": "subscribe", "symbols": "AAPL,TSLA"}
{"action": "unsubscribe", "symbols": "AAPL"}
```

**Trade (US/EU):**
```json
{"s": "AAPL", "p": 309.19, "c": [], "v": 2, "dp": false, "ms": "extended-hours", "t": 1787671313868}
```

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `s` | Symbol |
| `p` | Price |
| `v` | Volume/size |
| `c` | Condition codes (array) |
| `dp` | Dark pool (boolean) |
| `ms` | Market status: `open`, `closed`, `extended-hours` |
| `t` | Timestamp (epoch milliseconds) |

**Quote (US/EU):**
```json
{"s": "AAPL", "ap": 317.297, "as": 160, "bp": 316.988, "bs": 40, "t": 1784115291977}
```

**1-minute bar (US/EU candles):**
```json
{"s": "AAPL", "i": "1m", "t": 1787671260000, "o": 309.25, "h": 309.26, "l": 309.19, "c": 309.19, "v": 1101}
```

**Trading status (US/EU status):**
```json
{"s": "AAPL", "h": "T", "r": "0", "t": 1787731200000}
```

**Forex:**
```json
{"s": "EURUSD", "a": 1.1419, "b": 1.1416, "dc": "0.3005", "dd": "0.0034", "ppms": true, "t": 1784115288241}
```

**Crypto:**
```json
{"s": "ETH-USD", "p": "1881.0931", "q": "1.9e-7", "dc": "5.6041", "dd": "105.4177", "t": 1784115286805}
```

**Demo symbols:** 12 symbols work with `api_token=demo`, including AAPL, MSFT, TSLA (US), EURUSD (forex), BTC-USD and ETH-USD (crypto).

### Recent minute bars over REST (gap filling)

The real-time service keeps the recent closed 1-minute bars for US and EU symbols and exposes them over plain HTTPS on the WebSocket host — use it to fill a gap after a dropped connection without opening a socket:

```
GET https://ws.eodhistoricaldata.com/history?market=us&symbol=AAPL&api_token=YOUR_KEY
```

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `market` | Yes | string | `us` or `eu` |
| `symbol` | Yes | string | `AAPL` (US) or `GSK.LSE` (EU) |
| `api_token` | Yes | string | API key |

**Response:** JSON array of bars in the candles format: `[{"s": "AAPL", "i": "1m", "t": 1790583000000, "o": 340.82, "h": 340.82, "l": 340.82, "c": 340.82, "v": 80}, …]`

**Python Example:**

```python
import websocket
import json

def on_message(ws, message):
    data = json.loads(message)
    print(f"{data['s']}: {data.get('p', data.get('a', 'N/A'))}")

ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
    "wss://ws.eodhistoricaldata.com/ws/us?api_token=YOUR_KEY",
    on_message=on_message
)
ws.run_forever()
# After connection, send: {"action": "subscribe", "symbols": "AAPL,MSFT"}
```

## Error Handling

### HTTP Status Codes

| Code | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Success | Process response |
| 401 | Unauthenticated | Missing or invalid API key (plain-text body `Unauthenticated`). Check `api_token` / `Authorization` header |
| 402 | Payment Required | Daily API limit exhausted. Wait for midnight GMT or purchase extra calls |
| 403 | Forbidden | Key is valid but not entitled: wrong plan, demo key outside the demo symbol set, marketplace product not subscribed |
| 404 | Not Found | Unknown symbol/exchange (`Symbol not found`) or wrong path |
| 422 | Unprocessable | Missing/invalid required parameter; body is `{"errors": {"<field>": ["…"]}}` |
| 429 | Too Many Requests | Exceeded 1,000 req/min. Implement backoff |
| 500 | Server Error | Retry with backoff |

### Error Response Format

```json
{
  "error": "Error message description",
  "code": 403
}
```

Invalid/expired tokens return plain text: `Unauthenticated`

### Python Error Handling

```python
import requests

def fetch_eodhd(url, params):
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        return response.json()
    elif response.status_code == 401:
        raise Exception("Missing or invalid API key.")
    elif response.status_code == 402:
        raise Exception("API limit exceeded. Wait for midnight GMT or buy extra calls.")
    elif response.status_code == 403:
        raise Exception("Not entitled: upgrade plan or use a real key instead of demo.")
    elif response.status_code == 429:
        raise Exception("Rate limit exceeded. Slow down requests.")
    else:
        response.raise_for_status()
```

- **Power BI**: Custom connector for EOD, Intraday, and Fundamental data
- **NinjaTrader**: Adapter via NinjaScript import (.ZIP)
- **WordPress Plugin**: Shortcodes for prices, fundamentals, tables, news, currency converter
- **Chrome Extension**: Real-time prices data bar + currency converter
- **Windows Downloader**: No-code, multi-threading, proxy, Metastock/Amibroker CSV formats (open-source on GitHub)

- **XLQ2**: C++ application by QMatix, 700+ formulae, COM interface

- **Telegram Bot (EODHDSignals)**: Free bot with buy/sell alerts for SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, BBANDS strategies

## AI Integrations
**Docs:** [MCP Server for AI](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/mcp-server-for-financial-data-by-eodhd), [Claude Code plugin](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/eodhd-claude-skills-teach-your-ai-assistant-the-entire-financial-api)


### MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)

Official MCP server exposing the whole EODHD API as 90+ read-only tools, 3 prompt templates and 100+ embedded documentation resources (looked up locally, zero API calls). Two deployments share one codebase:

| Version | URL | Auth | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| v1 | `https://mcp.eodhd.com/v1/mcp?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY` | API key in the URL (an `Authorization: Bearer` header also works) | ChatGPT connectors, Claude Code, LangChain/OpenAI agents, any programmatic MCP client |
| v2 | `https://mcp.eodhd.com/v2/mcp` | OAuth 2.1 (built-in authorization server) | Claude Desktop and other OAuth-native clients |

**Setup examples:**

```bash
# Claude Code
claude mcp add eodhd --transport http "https://mcp.eodhd.com/v1/mcp?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY"
```

Claude Desktop: Settings → Extensions → Add → paste `https://mcp.eodhd.com/v2/mcp` and approve the OAuth consent. ChatGPT: Settings → Connectors → Developer mode → add the v1 URL.

**Tool families:** prices (EOD, intraday, live, extended quotes, real-time minute bars, tick data), fundamentals (incl. bulk), dividends/splits, technicals, news/sentiment, calendars, insider Form 4, SEC filings, congressional trades, ASX corporate actions, commodities, macro/economic events, US Treasury, interest rates and funding stress, credit & sovereign risk, sanctions, real estate, exchanges/search/ID mapping/screener, CBOE indices, marketplace (options, index constituents, tick data, TradingHours, PRAAMS, InvestVerte ESG), plus helpers `resolve_ticker`, `get_support_resistance_levels`, `retrieve_description_by_id`.

**Source:** https://github.com/EodHistoricalData/EODHD-MCP-Server (v1) and https://github.com/EodHistoricalData/EODHD-MCP-Server-v2 (v2, `.mcpb` bundle in Releases).

### Claude Code plugin (skills + MCP + agent)

One-command install that teaches Claude Code (and Codex) the entire API: an OAuth MCP connection, 13 skills, a `financial-analyst` agent, 72 endpoint guides, 28 reference docs, 7 plan guides and a dependency-free Python client.

```
/plugin marketplace add EodHistoricalData/eodhd-claude-skills
/plugin install eodhd@eodhd-claude-skills
```

**GitHub:** https://github.com/EodHistoricalData/eodhd-claude-skills

### ChatGPT Assistant

Custom assistant that retrieves data directly from EODHD servers. Handles real-time prices, fundamentals, historical data, analysis, and visualizations. Requires an API token.

### For agents reading this file

- Machine-readable spec: OpenAPI 3.1 at https://github.com/EodHistoricalData/EODHD-openapi (`openapi.yaml`)
- Prefer the `Authorization: Bearer` header so the key never lands in logs
- Newer endpoints paginate with `page[limit]`/`page[offset]` and return `links.next`; older ones use `limit`/`offset`
- Every error body is JSON except `401 Unauthenticated`, which is plain text

| Data Type | Update Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| US EOD (NYSE/NASDAQ) | 16:15 EST | 15 min after close |
| US Mutual Funds / PINK / OTCBB | 3:00-6:00 AM EST next day | |
| International EOD | 2-3 hours after close | |
| Intraday (US) | 2-3 hours after close | |
| Forex EOD | Every 4 hours from 00:00 GMT | |
| Crypto EOD | Every 4 hours from 00:00 GMT | |
| Fundamentals | 02:00-04:00 UTC daily | Nightly batch |
| Financial Statements | Quarterly, 24-48 hours after filing | |
| News (major stocks) | Every 15 minutes | |
| Options | 10 PM - 12 AM EST daily | |
| ECB Exchange Rates | ~17:00 CET | |
| API Call Counter | Resets at midnight GMT | |

### Caching Recommendations

| Data | Cache Duration |
|---|---|
| EOD prices | Until next trading day |
| Fundamentals (highlights) | 24 hours |
| Fundamentals (financials) | 7 days |
| News | 30-60 minutes |
| Live quotes | Do not cache |

## Data Coverage Details

### Delisted Stocks

- Delisted after 2018: fundamentals + dividends/splits + EOD + intraday (after 2021)
- Delisted before 2018: EOD data only
- Get delisted tickers: `GET /exchange-symbol-list/{EXCHANGE}?delisted=1`
- 26,000+ US tickers (from January 2000), 42,000+ international
- Important for survivorship-bias-free backtesting

### Government Bonds (GBOND)

Coverage spans 20+ countries: Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, France, Germany, Greece, India, Indonesia, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, UK, US. Maturities from 1 month to 30 years.

### Money Market (MONEY)

ECB exchange rates (EUR vs 30+ currencies), Norges Bank rates (NOK vs 30+ currencies), EURIBOR (1W/1M/3M/6M/12M), SOFR, EFFR, LIBOR, ECB rates, EUR 10Y IRS, US 15Y/30Y mortgage rates, Canada Prime Rate.

### Forex Sessions

- Asian: 23:00-08:00 GMT
- European: 07:00-16:00 GMT
- North American: 13:00-22:00 GMT
- Highest volume: European/NA overlap (13:00-16:00 GMT)

### Close vs Adjusted Close

- `close`: Raw closing price (unadjusted)
- `adjusted_close`: Adjusted for splits and dividends using Chicago Booth algorithm (4 decimal places)
- Use `adjusted_close` for historical comparisons and backtesting

### EPS Data

EODHD provides non-GAAP EPS when available, GAAP otherwise. GAAP follows SEC standards; Non-GAAP excludes one-time items.

---

## Edge Cases & Gotchas

1. Bulk EOD `symbols` parameter does NOT work for `type=splits` and `type=dividends`
2. Demo key does NOT work for the Search API
3. MATLAB should use HTTP (not HTTPS) via `nonsecure.eodhd.com`
4. R language also recommended to use HTTP for older versions
5. Earnings Trends is JSON-only due to nested structure
6. Calendar Dividends uses deep-object style filters (`filter[symbol]`) unlike other calendar endpoints
7. Intraday `from`/`to` parameters use **Unix timestamps (seconds, UTC)**, NOT YYYY-MM-DD date strings
8. Bulk Fundamentals limited to last 4 quarters/4 years; stocks only (no ETFs/funds)
9. Free plan: 1 year history only, 20 API calls/day
10. `filter=extended` on Bulk EOD only works for past 30 days of data
11. IPO `start_date` may be null; numeric fields may be 0 when unknown
12. Screener two-word sectors/industries need `match` instead of `=`
13. WebSocket requires re-subscribing on reconnect
14. WebSocket uses bare symbols: `AAPL` not `AAPL.US`, `EURUSD` not `EURUSD.FOREX`
15. News Word Weights may timeout on large date ranges — keep ranges narrow
16. Forex ticker format varies: `EURUSD.FOREX` (REST), `EURUSD` (WebSocket), `EUR.FOREX` (single currency)
17. Hong Kong tickers must be 4 digits with leading zeros (`0700.HK` not `700.HK`)
18. Crypto tickers use hyphen, forex tickers do not (`BTC-USD.CC` vs `EURUSD.FOREX`)
19. OHLC fields are raw/unadjusted; only `adjusted_close` accounts for corporate actions
20. Volume is adjusted for splits only, not dividends
21. US tick data lives at `/ticks/` **with a trailing slash** and needs both `from` and `to`; without them the server answers 404
22. PRAAMS screeners (`/mp/praams/explore/*`) are POST with a JSON body; GET returns 500. PRAAMS PDF reports require an `email` query parameter
23. `/cboe/index` requires all three of `filter[index_code]`, `filter[feed_type]`, `filter[date]`
24. TradingHours details/status take the FinID in a `market` parameter (`market=US.NYSE`); lookup ignores query filters, filter client-side
25. Newer datasets (rates, credit risk, real estate, SEC, sanctions, congress, commodities, ASX) use `filter[...]` / `page[limit]` / `page[offset]` and return a `{data, meta, links}` envelope; follow `links.next` for pagination
26. An invalid token is HTTP **401**, not 403; 403 means "valid key, no entitlement"
27. The real-time minute-bar history endpoint lives on the WebSocket host (`https://ws.eodhistoricaldata.com/history`), not under `/api`

---

## Versioning

EODHD uses **backwards-compatible updates** without URL-based versioning:
- Existing fields are never removed or renamed
- Existing endpoint URLs remain stable
- New fields may be added to responses
- Parse JSON flexibly (tolerate unknown fields)
- Breaking changes: minimum 30 days notice, 90 days support

---

## Common Code Patterns

### Python: Fetch Historical Prices

```python
import os
import requests

API_TOKEN = os.environ["EODHD_API_TOKEN"]
BASE_URL = "https://eodhd.com/api"

def get_eod(symbol, from_date, to_date):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/eod/{symbol}"
    params = {
        "api_token": API_TOKEN,
        "from": from_date,
        "to": to_date,
        "fmt": "json"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

data = get_eod("AAPL.US", "2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")
```

### Python: Fetch Fundamentals with Filter

```python
def get_fundamentals(symbol, sections="Highlights,Valuation"):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/fundamentals/{symbol}"
    params = {
        "api_token": API_TOKEN,
        "filter": sections,
        "fmt": "json"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

data = get_fundamentals("AAPL.US")
print(f"P/E Ratio: {data['Highlights']['PERatio']}")
print(f"Market Cap: {data['Highlights']['MarketCapitalization']}")
```

### Python: Stock Screener

```python
import json

def screen_stocks(filters, limit=20):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/screener"
    params = {
        "api_token": API_TOKEN,
        "filters": json.dumps(filters),
        "limit": limit,
        "fmt": "json"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

# Large-cap tech stocks with low P/E
results = screen_stocks([
    ["market_capitalization", ">", 100000000000],
    ["sector", "=", "Technology"],
    ["pe", "<", 25]
])
```

### Python: Using Official SDK

```python
from eodhd import APIClient

api = APIClient("YOUR_API_TOKEN")

# Historical prices
prices = api.get_eod_data("AAPL.US", "2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")

# Fundamentals
fundamentals = api.get_fundamentals("AAPL.US")
```

### Python: ID Mapping

```python
def id_mapping(isin):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/id-mapping"
    params = {
        "api_token": API_TOKEN,
        "filter[isin]": isin
    }
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

result = id_mapping("US0378331005")  # Apple ISIN
```

### JavaScript: Fetch Prices

```javascript
const API_TOKEN = process.env.EODHD_API_TOKEN;
const BASE_URL = "https://eodhd.com/api";

async function getEOD(symbol, from, to) {
  const url = `${BASE_URL}/eod/${symbol}?api_token=${API_TOKEN}&from=${from}&to=${to}&fmt=json`;
  const response = await fetch(url);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
  return response.json();
}

const data = await getEOD("AAPL.US", "2024-01-01", "2024-12-31");
```

### curl: Common Requests

```bash
# Historical prices
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/AAPL.US?from=2024-01-01&to=2024-12-31&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Fundamentals (filtered)
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/fundamentals/AAPL.US?filter=Highlights,Valuation&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Technical indicator (RSI 14-day)
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/technical/AAPL.US?function=rsi&period=14&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# News with sentiment
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/news?s=AAPL.US&limit=10&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Stock screener
curl 'https://eodhd.com/api/screener?filters=[["sector","=","Technology"],["pe","<",25]]&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json'

# Macro indicator
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/macro-indicator/USA?indicator=gdp_growth_annual&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Upcoming earnings
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/calendar/earnings?from=2025-01-20&to=2025-01-31&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Bitcoin price
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/BTC-USD.CC?from=2024-01-01&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# EUR/USD forex
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/EURUSD.FOREX?from=2024-01-01&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Search by ISIN
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/search/US0378331005?api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# ID mapping
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/id-mapping?filter[isin]=US0378331005&api_token=YOUR_KEY"

# Check API usage
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/user?api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Same request with the key in a header instead of the URL
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" "https://eodhd.com/api/user?fmt=json"

# SEC 10-K financials, Form 4 insider filings, congressional trades
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/sec-filings/AAPL.US/10k?page[limit]=5&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/sec-filings/AAPL.US/form4?page[limit]=5&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/congressional-trades?symbol=NVDA&page[limit]=5&api_token=YOUR_KEY"

# Policy rates, SOFR, sovereign ratings, sanctions, commodities, real estate
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/rates/policy-rates?filter[central_bank]=FED&page[limit]=5&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/rates/reference-rates?filter[code]=SOFR&page[limit]=5&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/credit-risk/sovereign/credit-ratings?filter[country]=DEU&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/sanctions/entities?q=gazprom&page[limit]=5&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/commodities/historical/BRENT?interval=monthly&api_token=YOUR_KEY"
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/real-estate/US?filter[type]=real&filter[metric]=yoy&api_token=YOUR_KEY"

# Government bond
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/US10Y.GBOND?from=2024-01-01&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Money market rate
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/EURIBOR3M.MONEY?api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"
```
